subject.title: sandbox: keep workspaceAccess none workspaces writable

question: Should OpenClaw approve making the isolated `workspaceAccess: "none"` sandbox workspace writable while preserving real-workspace isolation and protected read-only mounts?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the repair broadens sandbox write authorization and needs explicit maintainer ownership before an automated fix PR is safe.

options.title: Approve isolated writable none
options.body: Implement the cross-backend fix so only the sandbox-owned workspace is writable for `none`, with live sandbox proof and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep none fail-closed
options.body: Leave `none` read-only and update docs/tool exposure to make the stricter restriction explicit.

options.title: Write policy first
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers publish the sandbox write policy for isolated workspaces, custom binds, skill roots, and remote backends.

recommendation.title: Approve isolated writable none
recommendation.body: Implement the cross-backend fix so only the sandbox-owned workspace is writable for `none`, with live sandbox proof and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest feature-history signal and the recent maintainer comment that kept this issue canonical over the strict gating PR.
